hook.text: Muhammad received his first revelation at age forty. Forty is the age of spiritual maturity in Islam.

buildup.text: The Quran mentions forty as a period of completion. Moses met God after forty nights. A soul forms in forty days.

discovery.text: In Sufi tradition, a chilla is a forty-day spiritual retreat—isolation, prayer, and fasting. Forty purifies.

twist.text: Both Islam and Christianity inherited forty from earlier Semitic traditions. The number preceded both religions.

climax.text: Forty connects Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. It's the shared sacred number across all three Abrahamic faiths.

quiz.question: At what age did Muhammad receive his first revelation?
